# hush-hush-node

> Official Node.js/TypeScript SDK for hush-hush, a sealed-secret object
> store with an audit log, generated from its OpenAPI spec. This site is
> the TypeDoc-generated API reference for the `@hush-hush/sdk` package.

The SDK exposes a single `Client` class for creating, reading, updating and
deleting sealed objects, querying who accessed them and when, and checking
what else references a given object. Reads need no credential; writes need
an API key. The package ships both ESM and CommonJS builds and targets
Node.js 22+.

## Docs

- [API reference index](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-node/): Module overview and the project README.
- [Client](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-node/classes/Client.html): The SDK's entry point — createObject, getObject, updateObject, deleteObject, usedBy, queryAuditLog.
- [ClientOptions](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-node/interfaces/ClientOptions.html): Constructor options, including the API key.
- [APIError](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-node/classes/APIError.html): Error thrown for a failed API call.
- [HushHushError](https://alrayyes.github.io/hush-hush-node/classes/HushHushError.html): Base error class for the SDK.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-node): Source, issue tracker, CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hush-hush/sdk): Install instructions and version history.
- [hush-hush](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush): The service this SDK is generated against.
